zh.title: 星宇航空空山金藝術機飛抵布拉格哈維爾機場
zh.summary: 星宇航空空山金藝術機抵達布拉格；於歐洲首個航點投入350座旗艦機。
body: 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作推出的A350-1000「空山金」彩繪機，於2026年9月1日捷克時間上午近9時順利飛抵布拉格哈維爾機場，機場方面特別安排水門儀式盛大迎接這架旗艦級藝術客機。此項名為STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA的跨界合作計畫，將機械構造與藝術美學互相結合。
布拉格哈維爾機場執行長拉夏克在記者會致詞時表示，這對布拉格機場而言是一個特別的早晨，並祝願星宇航空所有航班客滿。星宇航空公關長暨發言人梁文龍則表示，布拉格是星宇航空在歐洲的首個航點，作為台灣與歐洲之間的橋樑，也是公司全球擴張過程中的重大里程碑，在此航線部署彩繪機將提供旅客優質飛行體驗。
在客艙配置方面，該架STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA A350-1000客機共設有350個座位，包括4席頭等艙、40席商務艙、36席豪華經濟艙與270席經濟艙。捷克觀光局日本兼台灣辦事處主任巴士杰指出，星宇航空自8月1日起加入台捷直航營運，未來台北與布拉格每天均有航班往來，預期將顯著帶動雙向觀光與商務旅客流向捷克。
根據本站紀錄，這架「空山金」A350-1000客機先前於2026年8月16日抵達桃園國際機場，並於8月20日首航執飛台北至東京成田航線。該機與先前於7月交機的「空山銀」彩繪機共同組成雙機陣容，規劃投入國際熱門航線的定期航班服務。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines Sorayama Gold A350-1000 Lands at Prague Airport
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines landed its Sorayama Gold A350-1000 in Prague; the aircraft features 350 seats across four classes.
body: A STARLUX Airlines Airbus A350-1000 aircraft featuring the special "Sorayama Gold" livery arrived at Václav Havel Airport Prague at approximately 9:00 AM Czech time on September 1, 2026. The airport marked the arrival of the flagship aircraft with a traditional water cannon salute. The long-range jet represents part of the carrier's STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA project created in collaboration with Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama.

Radomír Lašák, Chief Executive Officer of Václav Havel Airport Prague, welcomed the carrier at a press conference, highlighting the significance of the arrival for the airport. STARLUX Airlines spokesperson Liang Wen-long stated that Prague serves as the airline's initial gateway in Europe and marks a key milestone in its global route network expansion, noting that deploying the custom-painted flagship aircraft on the route will enhance the passenger travel experience.

The STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA A350-1000 flagship aircraft features a total of 350 seats configured across four travel classes, comprising 4 First Class seats, 40 Business Class seats, 36 Premium Economy seats, and 270 Economy seats. Pavel Schoustal, Director of the Czech Tourism Authority Japan & Taiwan Office, noted that STARLUX entered the direct Taiwan-Czech route on August 1, with daily flight connectivity expected to stimulate reciprocal tourism and business travel between the regions.

According to historical records, this second A350-1000 art aircraft arrived at Taoyuan International Airport on August 16, 2026, following its acceptance in France. The aircraft was subsequently deployed on the Taipei-Tokyo Narita route on August 20, joining the previously delivered "Sorayama Silver" aircraft to form a dual-liveried flagship fleet assigned to scheduled international services.

zh.title: 李奧納多直升機事業部任命新任總經理
zh.summary: Leonardo直升機事業部任命Stefano Villanti為新任總經理
body: 義大利航太與國防企業Leonardo旗下直升機事業部Leonardo Helicopters宣布，任命Stefano Villanti為新任總經理，自即日起生效。
Villanti曾於麥肯錫（McKinsey）任職，於2015年加入公司，歷任國際政府業務部門資深副總裁、銷售部門資深副總裁，自2023年起負責直升機事業部的行銷與銷售業務。
Leonardo Helicopters在2025年交付182架旋翼機，在西方直升機製造商渦輪直升機市場排名第二，僅次於空中巴士（Airbus）直升機公司，市占率約為五分之一至四分之一間。

en.title: Leonardo appoints Stefano Villanti as new Managing Director of helicopters division
en.summary: Leonardo Helicopters appoints Stefano Villanti as new Managing Director, effective immediately.
body: Leonardo Helicopters, the rotorcraft division of the Italian aerospace and defense group, has appointed Stefano Villanti as its new Managing Director with immediate effect.

Before this appointment, Villanti, a former McKinsey consultant, held several leadership positions within Leonardo's aerospace division. He joined the company in 2015 as Senior Vice President at the International Government Business Unit and later became Senior Vice President of Sales, and since 2023, Senior Vice President Marketing and Sales at the Helicopters Division.

Leonardo Helicopters delivered 182 rotorcraft in 2025, ranking second among Western helicopter makers in the turbine helicopter market, following Airbus Helicopters, with roughly between one fifth and one quarter of the market.
